statement: The next natural question is how the bound scales with the dataset size m. In general, one cannot say much. Indeed, if f is just random noise, it is clear that it is not possible to get a small population loss, although for long enough training time T one could potentially learn the training dataset. However, we conjecture that if the target f is reasonably nice, one can get a bound of order LZ (hT ) ≲ logmm by selecting T ∼ log m. To be more explicit, we consider a simple setting, where f is a linear combination of finitely many spherical harmonics (see Appendix C.1 for more details).
